name: windanvil-commander
description: Privately connect ChatGPT to WindAnvil's signed Blade tools on an authorized host over an outbound OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel.

interface.longDescription: Read-only diagnostics, bounded search, Git metadata and approved signed operations on a private WindAnvil Blade host. Requires the operator's configured Secure MCP Tunnel; it is not an unrestricted terminal or Desktop Commander replacement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check WindAnvil Commander health and admitted capabilities before using a host tool.
